description.value: The Elkford Aquatic Centre is a municipally operated, family-friendly facility serving this remote East Kootenay mountain community, offering a four-lane pool, two water slides, a diving board, a whirlpool hot tub, and an electric sauna. The building also houses the Elkford Public Library and a rentable multi-purpose meeting room, making it a genuine community hub. Cycling visitors arriving in Elkford will find it a rare chance to soak tired muscles with views of the Rocky Mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the District of Elkford's municipal aquatic centre at 816C Michel Road, featuring a four-lane pool, hot tub, electric sauna, two slides, and wheelchair accessibility — all corroborating OSM tags. The OSM phone number +1-204-943-9933 carries a 204 area code (Manitoba), which is inconsistent with an Elkford, BC location; no phone number appears in the scraped website content to provide a correct value. Bike parking, washrooms, showers, and water bottle refill are not explicitly mentioned in the website content, so all are marked null per evidence rules despite being plausible for a facility of this type.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating municipal aquatic facility in a remote cycling destination offering hot tub and sauna access — a genuine amenity for touring cyclists passing through Elkford.
